title: Rendezvous with Rama
author: Arthur C. Clarke
summary: A huge cylindrical object enters the solar system and a single human crew has just enough time to board it. They explore its vast interior, which seems built by someone who has no interest in them.
readIf: you love the thrill of exploring a giant, unexplained alien object.
skipIf: you want answers, characters with strong personalities or an alien who appears and talks.

pairings.reason: The same author's more philosophical vision of humanity meeting forces far greater than itself.
Another expedition into a baffling, unexplained zone, with a much more disturbing mood.
A very different tone, but shares the pleasure of clever people solving practical problems in space.
